_doc: Map 1 world machinery tuning (MAPS.md: power-on event, pylon holdouts, lift). exfil: the campaign beacon at the yard gate (T-033), see map00.json for the fields.

requiem._doc: T-181 the Four Bells made easier (QuestBell): each small bell's shot box is bell_hit_box_m wide (a near miss rings it; the 0.64 m box let bursts and the specimen tank's frame eat the rounds), an explosion within bell_splash_m rings it, and from bells_glow_after (the music box opened) the four live bells glow faintly and chime their note every bells_chime_s, so they can be found by eye and ear; a bell already rung in this run never resets the sequence (map01_requiem s6 repeat_ok). The Chapel bell stays lit longer (bell_lit_solo / bell_lit_coop below; relight cooldown 60 and summon delay 20 are the defaults) and s4 counts the Foreman near the altar too (its near / near_m).
requiem._bell_lit: T-181: the Chapel bell stays lit 150 s solo / 120 s co-op (was 90 / 75): the Foreman comes 20 s after it lights, and the squad had a minute to bring him into the Chapel and kill him there; relight cooldown and summon delay unchanged

round_bosses._doc: T-240 the undead horses on Kaltenbrunn: on the surface only

round_boss_arena._doc: T-240 the surface yards only (the navmesh is baked for a 0.5 m agent and the doors are 2 m, but the lift cage, the stairs and the galleries are no place for a horse): it comes in by the north gate (arrive; without it: the far side of these zones from the squad, on the yard's level) and never follows below ground (the siege rule).

horses.name: YardHorse
horses._doc: T-271 the mine's cart horse (T-240's rideable horse, T-262's tack chest), tied at a hitching rail on the Minehead yard's east wall between the drums in the corner and the Rail Yard door (the door is 6 m south of the rail, the chest 4.5 m). yaw -90 = it faces east, toward the rail and the wall. zones: the two surface yards (the Rail Yard once its door is open); never the Kaue's doorways that lead below, the Administration or the barracks. The rail's collider is on the map-edge layer, the chest has none: the baked navmesh is untouched. Measured by probe_map_site and walked by smoke_map_detail.

sherman_event._doc: T-271 Kaltenbrunn's round-40 set piece: THE RAID ONLY (ShermanEvent with "tank": false; AirRaid). No Sherman here: the yard's gate is one solid piece of the baked shell and the buried rail line ends at the Rail Yard's north wall, so a tank has no way in until the generator gives it one (docs/u21/t271_map_detail_base.md). Round 40: a dive bomber comes down the valley on the locomotive in the Rail Yard (stuka_target), then the siren and sixty seconds of bombs on the open yards (bomb_zones); every roof is a shelter (shelter_roof: the Kaue, the barracks' rooms, the lift house) and so is everything in shelter_zones (the Administration, the stairs, the mine). shelter_points: where a bot outside runs to. raid / stuka: this map's banners over sherman.json's.
